requirements.title: External durable Domain State
requirements.source_claim: Business facts and workflow state should be separated from conversation history.
requirements.real_problem: Conversation context is volatile, provider-specific working memory and cannot be the system of record.
requirements.state_machine: STATE_DECLARED → VERSION_BOUND → DURABLY_COMMITTED → READ_BACK → REPLAYED → SUPERSEDED | ROLLED_BACK
positive_controls: restart and replay preserve exact state version
mutation_controls: conversation summary accepted as canonical state
blockers: canonical Bettor owner issue and exact state schema are not yet bound
requirements.next_transition: Bind owner interface through INCEPTION-C1, then emit A1 owner packet.

requirements.title: Deterministic macro DAG with bounded local autonomy
requirements.source_claim: High-risk macro flow should be a deterministic state machine while exploratory work runs in bounded sub-agents.
requirements.real_problem: Long ReAct loops drift, hide failure state, and blur write authority.
requirements.state_machine: REQUEST_BOUND → TASK_DAG_COMPILED → WAVES_ADMITTED → CANDIDATES_RECEIVED → GATES_APPLIED → REDUCED
positive_controls: disjoint lanes execute without false serialization
blockers: generic EAS-K implementation is still a draft
requirements.next_transition: Consume admitted EAS-K bytes and compile the profile DAG.

requirements.title: Provider-bound context budget policy
requirements.source_claim: Context usage should be monitored and trigger a soft checkpoint before a hard compaction.
requirements.real_problem: Fixed percentages and character-based token estimation do not reliably model provider limits or active transactions.
positive_controls: provider tokenizer agrees with accounting within declared tolerance
mutation_controls: character count promoted as exact tokens
requirements.next_transition: Freeze context-budget-policy.v1 and route to runtime-env.

requirements.title: Atomic tool transaction compaction boundary
requirements.source_claim: Compaction should preserve complete assistant/tool/result transactions and a recent active tail.
requirements.real_problem: A cut point that only skips leading tool messages can still split an assistant tool call from ordered results.
positive_controls: one-to-many and parallel tool results stay ordered and complete
no safe boundary routes to checkpoint/cancel
blockers: fault and concurrency controls not executed
requirements.next_transition: Freeze safe-tool-transaction.v1 and emit A1 tests.
claims_not_proven: Lossless compaction across all provider message formats

requirements.title: Durable VFS checkpoint, reconstruction and recovery
requirements.source_claim: State snapshots and history should be written to a VFS and used to reconstruct a smaller context.
requirements.real_problem: An in-memory dictionary is not durable, concurrent, encrypted, recoverable or tenant-isolated.
requirements.state_machine: SNAPSHOT_PREPARED → VALIDATED → ATOMICALLY_COMMITTED → RECONSTRUCTED → RECOVERY_PROBED → ACTIVE | ROLLED_BACK
positive_controls: crash before and after activation preserves one recoverable active version
blockers: durable store owner and schema not bound
requirements.next_transition: Route exact storage and harness interfaces to Bettor/runtime-env owner issues.

requirements.title: Capability-aware steering at declared sync points
requirements.source_claim: A watchdog may request a checkpoint, tool call or cancellation when reasoning exceeds a budget.
requirements.real_problem: Assistant prefill, abort, streaming visibility and hidden-reasoning access differ by provider and may be absent.
requirements.state_machine: CAPABILITIES_DISCOVERED → SYNC_POINT_OBSERVED → ACTION_PROPOSED → POLICY_CHECKED → CHECKPOINT | TOOL_REQUEST | CANCEL | NO_ACTION | HUMAN_ESCALATE
positive_controls: steering cannot interrupt active tool transaction
requirements.next_transition: Create runtime/provider owner packets after profile contracts freeze.
